name: Sun and Moon Overlay
description: Today's sunrise and sunset, the day's length, or the moon's phase at the device's location, as outlined text for an overlay zone. Calculated on the device: no internet, no key.

properties.name: view
properties.title: View
properties.description: sun: today's sunrise and sunset. daylight: how long the sun is up today, and the change since yesterday. moon: the moon's phase and how much of it is lit. The place is the device's location (System settings).

properties.name: showIcon
properties.title: Show Icon
properties.description: A drawing before the text: the sun, or the moon at its phase.

properties.name: weight
properties.title: Weight
properties.description: How heavy the letters are. bold: the font's bold face. heavy: bolder than the font has it.

properties.name: offset
properties.title: Edge Offset
properties.description: How far the text is from the screen's edge, in pixels: from the top edge in a top zone, from the bottom edge in a bottom zone.
